source_selection: NLL then Brier then AUROC; equal-centre candidate selection
optimization: one exact full-source objective update per epoch; two-pass VJP replay preserves author dropout and DGR source-only centre buffers, full within-centre rank .1; SGD momentum .9 for DGR, AdamW otherwise
readout_adapter: positive-minus-negative class logits plus detached patient Anchor; no new patient outcome feature
Track_A: same FR1 source-only 8D features and full anchor; original hidden512 blocks retained, not capacity-matched
Track_B: same original frozen independent-frame JEV contrasts, per-source-coordinate std scaling with no target fitting; author learned input projections retained
RRT: region_num4 for bag120; original region/cross-region/EPEG retained; computational sequence partition, no WSI physical-coordinate claim
ACMIL: MBA5, STKIMtop10 drop.6, branch label auxiliary and attention cosine diversity retained
DGR: lesion vectors5, mutable positive/negative source centres, diversity+triplet .1 each after epoch10; logdet Gram computed double for numerical stability
WiKG: feature-derived directed top-k graph, topk min(6, available), original GlobalAttention pool
